Dear Mayor Quimby and Mr. Skinner,

We, the undersigned, hereby submit a petition to you, the City Council of Springfield, to take immediate action to protect our environment from the harmful effects of pollution and deforestation. We are deeply concerned about the deteriorating air and water quality in our city, which is affecting the health and well-being of our citizens. We urge you to implement stricter regulations on industrial emissions and to promote sustainable practices in our community. Furthermore, we request that you allocate more resources to environmental education and awareness programs. By taking these measures, we believe that Springfield can become a leader in environmental protection and set an example for other cities to follow. Thank you for your attention to this matter. Sincerely, Lisa Simpson
